title: TRACE: Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding for Communication-efficient Distributed Edge Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.22435v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed Transformer inference across co-located edge devices is fundamentally communication-bound, as exchanging activations between sequence-parallel partitions dominates inference latency under commodity edge bandwidths. Existing compression schemes reduce this cost but retain a structural bottleneck: the received data must still undergo key/value projection before attention can proceed, serializing computation behind communication. This paper presents Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding (Trace), a framework that addresses these limitations. Trace places a Vector Quantizer (VQ) at the post-attention residual of every Transformer layer and precomputes codebook-indexed key/value representations. During inference, exchanged activations are encoded into compact codebook indices, allowing receivers to directly recover keys and values through table lookup instead of executing the downstream computations required to derive

translated_title: TRACE：面向通信高效分布式边缘推理的Transformer残差激活码本编码
translated_abstract: 跨共置边缘设备的分布式Transformer推理本质上受通信瓶颈制约，因为在商用边缘带宽下，序列并行分区之间交换激活值主导了推理延迟。现有的压缩方案虽然降低了这一成本，但仍存在结构性瓶颈：接收到的数据仍需经过键/值投影后才能进行注意力计算，导致计算被串行化在通信之后。本文提出了Transformer残差激活码本编码（Trace）框架来解决这些局限性。Trace在每个Transformer层的注意力后残差处放置一个向量量化器（VQ），并预计算以码本索引的键/值表示。在推理过程中，交换的激活值被编码为紧凑的码本索引，使接收方能够通过查表直接恢复键和值，而无需执行推导它们所需的下游计算。
tldr: TRACE通过在每个Transformer层的注意力后残差处引入向量量化器，将交换的激活值编码为紧凑码本索引，使接收方通过查表直接恢复键/值表示，从而消除通信后串行计算的结构性瓶颈，实现通信高效的分布式边缘推理。
en_tdlr: TRACE introduces a vector quantizer at the post-attention residual of each Transformer layer to encode exchanged activations into compact codebook indices, allowing receivers to directly recover keys and values via table lookup and eliminating the structural bottleneck that serializes computation behind communication in distributed edge inference.
